name: get_holidays
description: Get all public holidays for a country and year. Returns holiday names and dates. Provide country code (e.g., "US", "GB", "DE") and year.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, DE, FR)

year.description: The year to retrieve holidays for (e.g., 2025)

name: is_today_holiday
description: Check if today is a public holiday in a given country. Returns whether it's a holiday and the holiday name if applicable. Provide country code (e.g., "US", "GB").

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, DE, FR)

name: next_holidays
description: Get upcoming public holidays from today onward for a country. Returns holiday names and dates. Provide country code (e.g., "US", "GB", "DE").

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, GB, DE, FR)
